question: Which of the following is true for all acute angles A?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In trigonometry, the co-functions of complementary angles are always equal.

The sine of an acute angle is always identical to the cosine of its complementary angle.

Hence, for any given acute angle A, sin A = cos(90° − A).

**∴ The correct answer is sin A = cos(90° − A).**
